posting.title: Unpaid Data Science Fellowship
posting.description:
About the role:
Civic Impact Lab runs an unpaid six-month fellowship for people who want to apply data science to social-good projects.

Responsibilities:
You will build ML models in Python for non-profit partner organizations, working with SQL and AWS on small-scale civic data projects.

Requirements:
Strong hands-on experience with Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas), SQL, and AWS is required. This is an unpaid fellowship position — fellows are expected to have independent means of financial support for the duration of the programme.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid, based in our Copenhagen co-working space.

What we offer:
Mentorship from senior practitioners, a certificate of completion, and a strong professional network in the civic-tech space.
